189

Skilled Independent Visa (Subclass 189)

The Subclass 189 visa is a points-tested skilled migration visa that allows you to live, work, and study anywhere in Australia permanently. No state sponsorship or employer sponsorship is required.

⚠️

Important Notice: The content on this page is for general information only. Australian visa policies and requirements are subject to change at any time. Always refer to the official Department of Home Affairs website for the most current and accurate information.

Who Is This Visa For?

Have a nominated occupation on the Skilled Occupation List

Have a positive skills assessment for their occupation

Have a competitive EOI points score

Under 45 years of age at time of invitation

Meet English language requirements

Basic Requirements

Age

  • •Must be under 45 years of age when invited

English Language

  • •Competent English is the minimum requirement
  • •Higher scores earn additional points

Skills Assessment

  • •Must have a positive skills assessment
  • •From a relevant assessing authority for your occupation

EOI Score

  • •Minimum of 65 points
  • •Higher scores improve invitation chances

Health & Character

  • •Must meet health requirements
  • •Must meet character requirements

Application Process

1

Skills Assessment

Get your qualifications assessed by a relevant authority

2

English Test

Complete an approved English language test

3

Expression of Interest

Submit your EOI through SkillSelect

4

Wait for Invitation

Wait to receive an invitation to apply

5

Submit Application

Lodge your visa application within the invitation period

6

Visa Grant

Wait for processing and visa grant

Frequently Asked Questions

Does the 189 visa require state sponsorship?
No. The 189 visa is an independent skilled migration visa that does not require state sponsorship or family sponsorship.
What is the typical EOI score for the 189 visa?
EOI scores are updated regularly. Please refer to the Australian Department of Home Affairs website for the latest data. Content on this site is for reference only.
How long does the 189 visa processing take?
Processing times vary depending on individual circumstances, typically ranging from several months to over a year. Please rely on official information.
Is the 189 visa permanent residency?
Yes, the 189 visa is an Australian Permanent Resident (PR) visa.
Can I live anywhere in Australia with a 189 visa?
Yes, 189 visa holders can live and work anywhere in Australia.
